locations.note: A transfer student moves into the Iwatodai dorm and joins S.E.E.S., which climbs Tartarus, the tower Gekkoukan High becomes during the hidden Dark Hour; FES adds The Answer, in which Aigis and the others are trapped in the dorm on the last day of March.
On a summer holiday on Yakushima, S.E.E.S. meets and recruits Aigis, a Persona-wielding android with an inexplicable need to stay near the protagonist.
Gekkoukan's November class trip takes the second-years to Kyoto, where they stay at an inn and Yukari and Mitsuru talk things out on the bank of the Kamo River.

routes.name: S.E.E.S.
routes.note: From the Iwatodai dorm to the summer at Yakushima, the November trip to Kyoto, and back to Tartarus for the last climb.
